name: ROMAN_NAIL
canonical: a single large iron Roman crucifixion nail, a hand-forged dark spike some five to seven inches long with a thick squared shank tapering to a brutal point and a rough flat head, pitted and rust-dark. The nail driven through hands and feet — NOT a modern smooth wire nail, NOT a small carpentry tack
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
